primary.body:
Rewrites CanteenX end to end. The previous build demoed well but had several
paths that could not work in production, and a few that were actively unsafe.

## Security fixes

- **Free orders.** `POST /api/payment/verify` had no auth, and because every seeded merchant carried the literal key `rzp_test_YOUR_KEY_ID`, the gateway selection fell through to a mock that accepted any payload and returned `"captured"`. Anyone with curl could mark an order paid. Payments now verify an HMAC signature, re-confirm status and amount with Razorpay, and treat a signed idempotent webhook as the authoritative confirmation.
- **`markOrderPaid` is gone.** It let a customer flip their own order to paid with no payment involved.
- **Authorization.** Only 5 of 23 queries carried any policy; anonymous callers could read other users' carts, orders, payment history, complaints, and per-canteen revenue. Every field now declares a policy, and a test fails the build if one is ever added without it.
- Committed fallback secrets removed; config fails fast instead. Razorpay secrets no longer stored as plaintext columns. CSRF double-submit added, refresh-token rotation with reuse detection implemented (the previous refresh cookie was issued and never read, so every session died silently after 15 minutes).

## Correctness fixes

- **Money is integer paise**, not `Float`.
- **Stock is transactional** — reserved at checkout via a conditional UPDATE with a rowcount check, and returned on cancellation. Previously it was decremented and never restored, so every abandoned checkout leaked inventory permanently.
- **Order status is an enum with a transition table**; it was unvalidated free text.
- **One schema source of truth.** `create_all()` at import time plus three competing migration systems replaced with a single Alembic baseline. `alembic check` runs in CI. The `script.py.mako` template had its `${upgrades}` placeholder replaced with `pass`, so every autogenerated migration came out empty — that is why the old ones were hand-written and drifted.
- Several core mutations (`create_canteen`, `create_menu_item`, `create_complaint`, `register_user`) raised on **every** call by assigning to read-only camelCase property shims. That whole layer is deleted.

## Bugs found by testing this build

- **WebSocket handshake** died with a `TypeError` — FastAPI injects `websocket`, not `request`. No subscription had ever connected.
- **Connection-pool exhaustion.** A dependency resolved on a WS route is held for the whole connection, so each subscription pinned a pooled DB connection. Hit live: the entire API started returning `QueuePool limit of size 5 overflow 2 reached`.
- **A race in `user()`** set its memoisation flag before awaiting the query, so a second concurrent subscription read `None` and rejected a valid user on timing alone.
- **Every upload would have failed in production.** Filenames were generated as `menu/<uuid>.webp`, and the storage server rejects any name containing a slash. Also fixed: the upload path, the separate read host, and taking the path from the response (its `url` field points at the wrong domain).
- `PaymentsDisabledError` was swallowed by a broad `except` and reported as a generic payment failure.

## Frontend

Rewritten: ~2,200 lines of unreachable code removed, TypeScript strict on, GraphQL types generated rather than hand-maintained, Tailwind v4, Apollo rebuilt with CSRF, 401-refresh-retry, and a `graphql-ws` split. The cart existed in three incompatible places at once and is now server-only. Promotions, bulk orders, vendor settings, inventory and pre-order were pure `useState` mockups and now persist. New design system on the ADK DEV brand violet with working light/dark. Both consoles get the mobile navigation they never had.

## Verification

- 32 backend tests, including regression tests for each bug above
- 39-check end-to-end smoke script
- Order lifecycle, wallet payment, live subscription updates, and image upload all confirmed in Chrome
- ruff / tsc / eslint clean; `vite build` succeeds; `alembic check` reports no drift

## Not done

Responsive behaviour at 375/768/1440 is **not** verified in a browser, and Lighthouse has not been run. The work is in (mobile drawers, table scroll containers, focus rings, `aria-live`, reduced-motion) but unverified.

Setup, environment variables, and deployment are documented in `DEVDOC.md`.
